summary_1line: Yayati and allied kings ascend to heaven, after which the lineage from Puru through Bharata to later Kuru ancestors is recounted.

image_candidates.scene_text: Five blazing golden chariots appear in the sky as Yayati and the kings mount them and ascend together toward heaven.
King Sivi races ahead on the celestial path while the others watch in awe, his merit carrying him foremost toward heaven.
The exiled king Samvarana and the Bharatas dwell in a forest fortress by the Sindhu as the sage Vasishtha arrives to restore their fate.
